sections.title: 10-Day Ireland: Art, Heritage & Scenic Landscapes
sections.subtitle: Introduction
sections.html:
10-Day Ireland: Art, Heritage & Scenic Landscapes

Experience Ireland’s vibrant culture, storied heritage, and breathtaking scenery on a 10-day journey. Explore Dublin’s historic streets, marvel at the Giant’s Causeway, discover artisan crafts, and travel through iconic landscapes from the Cliffs of Moher to the Ring of Kerry. Enjoy a blend of art, history, and natural beauty.

sections.title: Day 1 - Welcome to Dublin
sections.html:
Arrive in Dublin

Arrive in Dublin and settle into your hotel.

Guided Walking Tour of Dublin

Discover the Irish capital on a guided walking tour, exploring its lively streets, historic architecture, and cultural landmarks.

Evening at Leisure

Enjoy an evening at leisure.

sections.title: Day 2 - Dublin’s Literary & Historic Treasures
sections.html:
Sightseeing Tour of Dublin

Explore Dublin on a sightseeing tour. Visit Trinity College to see the celebrated Book of Kells, tour St. Patrick’s Cathedral, and wander through the Temple Bar district.

Visit Ulysses Rare Books

Stop by Ulysses Rare Books and enjoy free time in the afternoon.

sections.title: Day 3 - Ancient Ireland to Donegal
sections.html:
Travel via Hill of Tara

Travel north via the Hill of Tara, one of Ireland’s most significant ancient sites.

Visit Marble Arch Caves Global Geopark

Continue to the spectacular Marble Arch Caves Global Geopark.

Visit Enniskillen Castle

Visit Enniskillen Castle before arriving in Donegal for the evening.

Dinner

Dinner is included.

sections.title: Day 4 - Giant's Causeway & the North Coast
sections.html:
Full-day excursion to Giant's Causeway

Set out on a full-day excursion to the extraordinary Giant’s Causeway, famous for its dramatic basalt columns.

Visit Bushmills and historic distillery

Continue to Bushmills for lunch and a visit to the historic distillery, then return to Donegal.

Dinner

Dinner is included.

sections.title: Day 5 - Craft Traditions & Sligo
sections.html:
Visit Donegal Craft Village

Visit Donegal Craft Village to discover local artisans and traditional Irish craftsmanship.

Explore Sligo and Lunch

Continue to Sligo, with time to explore the town and enjoy lunch.

Travel to Kiltimagh

Travel to Kiltimagh for the night.

sections.title: Day 6 - Cliffs of Moher & County Kerry
sections.html:
Journey to the Cliffs of Moher

Journey to the breathtaking Cliffs of Moher and take in the Atlantic coastal scenery.

Continue through the Irish countryside to Listowel

Continue through the Irish countryside to Listowel, a charming market town with time for browsing and shopping.

Arrive in Killarney for the evening

Arrive in Killarney for the evening.

sections.title: Day 7 - Killarney at Your Own Pace
sections.html:
Leisure day in Killarney

Enjoy a leisure day in Killarney. Choose to explore the town, play golf, or relax with a spa treatment.

Optional memoryware assemblage mosaic workshop

An optional memoryware assemblage mosaic workshop with the group leader offers a creative way to reflect on the journey.

sections.title: Day 8 - Ring of Kerry & Muckross House
sections.html:
Ring of Kerry scenic excursion

Experience the beautiful Ring of Kerry on a scenic full-day excursion.

Stop at Kerry Bog Village Museum

Stop at Kerry Bog Village Museum during your Ring of Kerry excursion.

Visit Muckross House and Gardens

Continue to Muckross House and Gardens in Killarney National Park.

Dinner at Muckross House

Enjoy an included dinner at Muckross House before returning to Killarney.

sections.title: Day 9 - Blarney, Cashel & Return to Dublin
sections.html:
Travel toward Dublin with a stop at Blarney Woollen Mills

Travel toward Dublin with a stop at Blarney Woollen Mills for shopping and lunch.

Pause at the historic Rock of Cashel

Pause for a view and photo opportunity at the historic Rock of Cashel.

Continue to Dublin for your final evening

Continue to Dublin for your final evening.

sections.title: Day 10 - Farewell Ireland
sections.html:
Breakfast

Enjoy breakfast before departing for the airport and your onward journey home.
